# 2 Baruch Chapter 20 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 20:2 — "has waxed impatient" vs. "has run out of patience"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "has-waxed-impatient" | Literal compound; traditional English idiom |
| LOGOS | "has waxed impatient" | Formal, biblical register |
| PNEUMA | "has run out of patience" | Modern idiomatic; more vivid |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS adopted. "Waxed impatient" preserves the biblical register (cf. Num 21:4, Judg 16:16). "Run out of patience" is accurate but colloquial and loses the theological gravity.

---

## 20:3 — "Command your memory" — the unusual instruction

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Command-your-memory therefore to-go-into-the-forest" | Literal; preserves the striking phrase |
| LOGOS | "Command your memory therefore to go into the forest" | Formal, preserves the phrase |
| PNEUMA | "gather yourself and go into the forest" | Contextualizes — "gather yourself" explains the meaning |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS adopted. "Command your memory" is one of the most distinctive and theologically significant phrases in 2 Baruch — it reflects a Syriac concept of directed attention/interior withdrawal. PNEUMA's paraphrase "gather yourself" loses this unique element of the text.

---

## 20:6 — "your memorial" vs. "you in my memory"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "I-will-not-forget-your-memorial but-will-remember-it-forever" | Literal; "memorial" as formal term |
| LOGOS | "I will not forget your memorial but will remember it forever" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "I will never forget you; I will keep you in my memory forever" | Personalizes; "you" for "your memorial" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS adopted. "Your memorial" (Syriac dukhrana) is the formal term for a person's prophetic legacy and intercessory standing before God (cf. Ps 70:1 LXX). PNEUMA's "you" loses the specifically memorial/legacy dimension.

---

**Total disagreements this chapter: 3**
